title: Worker completion summary
description: Final chat message of a paseo-delegate worker after executing one phase. Enforced by the daemon in strict mode via --output-schema.

status.description: complete = all acceptance criteria attempted and verification run; blocked = cannot proceed, see blockers; failed = attempt made and did not succeed.

files_changed.description: Paths of every file created, modified, or deleted. Empty array for analysis-only phases.

verification.description: Commands run and their results (tests, build, lint).

blockers.description: Anything that prevented progress. Empty array when unblocked.

tooling_notes.description: Defects, surprises or workarounds in the TOOLS themselves — the gate, the harness, the CLI — as distinct from this phase's own work. "none" when there are none. The validator copies this verbatim into its verdict; it is never summarised or judged away.

handoff_notes.description: What the next agent must know: deltas vs the plan, decisions taken, fragile spots.
